headline: Regional trade deficit widens sharply
description: <p>ISLAMABAD: Pakistan’s trade deficit with nine neighbouring countries widened by 26.62 per cent to $4.97 billion during the first quarter of 2026-27 compared to $3.93bn in the corresponding period last year.</p> <p>The widening gap reflects a contraction in Pakistan’s exports to regional markets, largely due to reduced shipments to Afghanistan and Bangladesh.</p> <p>Trade with Afghanistan, including exports, has remained <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/1950983">suspended</a> since Oct 10, 2025, further weighing on overall export performance.</p
